title: Lifting natty is a waste of time
summary: Recorded on his phone in a forest at night, NH rebuts the meme that lifting natural is like working minimum wage and expecting to get rich. He argues the idea comes from impatient teenagers who have not started training and it pushes them toward SARMs and PEDs. Natural lifting rewards patience, and PEDs are like robbing a bank: faster, but paid for later.
claims: The 'lifting natty is a waste of time' idea is spread mostly by teenagers who have not yet trained
Believing natural lifting does not work makes PEDs inevitable; SARM users are mostly teens, some of whom have never trained
Experienced natural lifters must act as role models to restore hope in young lifters
Impatience and weakness to instant gratification make natural lifting a self-fulfilling failure
Stop asking how long until you look like someone; a physique is not built overnight
No natural with a decade of training regrets it; lifting is the best part of his life
Time saved with PEDs is paid back later with years of health complications, not just an earlier death
He looked like he did not lift for his first five years and still progresses every year
Natural potential is effectively unlimited if you give yourself the chance
Taking PEDs at 19 shows a lack of self-trust
If natural lifting is a minimum-wage job, PEDs are bank robbery: faster but with arrest or death as the price
Results achieved with a crutch can never bring pride or fulfilment; natural lifting builds pride and confidence
